items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: And it turns out that was Miami Steve Van Zandt, the guitarist and Bruce’s good friend. So thankfully he came up with some ideas on that one and we transcribed his ideas

ctx.x: And if it was not professionally done then you had to do some scrambling?

Well yeah, we had to do some writing sometimes, and on some very good records. This one always comes to mind, on “Born to Run” the Bruce Springsteen record. It was me, Mike and Sanborn and a great trombone player, Wayne Andre. We showed up at the session and there was music paper on our stands but they were blank. And I think they might have had some bar lines but sometimes they didn’t even have bar lines. So it became our job to write a chart. And this was a little out of our — I’ll never forget it — “Tenth…
This is very interesting for me because I’ve played that song with different bands so to hear that thing and remember that I’ve played [scats]. That’s great.
